item.title: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy and its founder to refund ₹546 cr
item.description: Markets regulator Sebi on Friday directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy Pvt Ltd (ASTAPL) and its Founder Avadhut Sathe to refund Rs 546.17 crore collected from participants for providing unregistered investment advisory and research analyst services, along with interest of Rs 67.87 crore. The regulator has also barred the academy and Sathe from accessing the securities market for two years or until compliance with the refund direction, whichever is later. In its 171-page final order, the regulator imposed a total penalty of Rs 11.5 crore on the academy, Sathe and Gouri Avadhut Sathe for violations of securities market regulations. The academy has been fined Rs 6 crore, Sathe has been fined Rs 4 crore, while Gouri Avadhut Sathe has been penalised Rs 1.5 crore. The regulator found that the academy and Sathe provided investment advice and research recommendations through paid programmes, sessions and WhatsApp groups without obtaining the required registration. It also found that ...
item.bs:keywords: Sebi, stock market trading, penalty

item.title: Sebi eases call-recording mandate for research analysts dealing with funds
item.description: Market regulator Sebi on Friday eased the mandatory requirement for research analysts to maintain call recordings of their interactions with institutional investors to reduce compliance burden and improve ease of doing business. In a circular, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) said research analysts and entities will no longer be mandatorily required to maintain call recordings of interactions with institutional investors. However, they will continue to be required to maintain records of their interactions with all clients, including prospective clients, through means such as signed physical records, emails, SMS messages, call recordings or any other legally verifiable method. The records are required to be maintained for five years. In cases where a dispute has been raised, the records will have to be preserved until its resolution. item.bs:keywords: Sebi eases call-recording norms for research analysts dealing with institutional investors
